in_marathi.name: Chinmayananda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness of the Absolute
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmayananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chinmayananda is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Chinmaya’, meaning consciousness of the absolute, and ‘Ananda’, meaning bliss. This name signifies the realization of the divine within, leading to a state of pure consciousness and joy.
